media:group.media:description:
Welcome to the Interactive Fitness World! 🎮🔥
A giant star-shaped portal tears open over a sunny meadow, linking the Mushroom Kingdom and Dream Land — a crowd of Waddle Dees pours through, and King Dedede leaps down right behind them. Mario teams up with Kirby, who tumbled through the portal too, to set the two worlds right. Every villain pair you beat runs off, and a new pair is waiting: King Dedede and Bowser Jr. at the Grassland Fortress, Meta Knight and Kamek in the Magic Castle, Marx and King Boo in the Prankster Ghost Theater, and finally Magolor, powered up by the Master Crown, side by side with Bowser at Bowser's Castle in the dimensional rift. 🍄⭐

⚡ HOW TO PLAY — THIS LEVEL: Start on the meadow road where the two worlds meet, with the star portal glowing over a green pipe at the end of the road, and learn the moves. Then run through the Grassland Fortress, the long halls of the Magic Castle, the Prankster Ghost Theater, and finally the stone bridge over the lava at Bowser's Castle in the dimensional rift.
